description: District heating network data for the city of Flensburg from 2014 to 2016 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Stadtwerke Flensburg GmbH. The data package contains flow temperatures and the overall heat load for the district heating network of the city Flensburg, Germany for the years 2014, 2015 and 2016. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
